name: Luminous Broodmoth
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever a creature you control without flying dies, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with a flying counter on it.
blocked_sentences: Whenever a creature you control without flying dies, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control with a flying counter on it.

needs.what: a last-known-information test of the keywords a dying creature had as it left the battlefield (603.10a), usable on a creature_dies trigger -- either a `not_keywords` trigger filter key answered from the departure snapshot, or a `keywords_had` value/condition beside `counters_had`, `power_had` and `toughness_had`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: TRIGGER_FILTER_KEYS has `keywords` but not `not_keywords`, and `matches_card_filter` reads `keywords` off the printed card face, not last-known derived characteristics. A creature returned by this very ability carries a flying counter, so it dies WITH flying; a printed-face check would see no flying and return it again for ever, and a creature granted flying by an anthem would wrongly be returned. The value language has `counters_had`, `power_had`, `toughness_had` and `auras_had` but no keyword equivalent. The return itself is expressible (`return_from_graveyard` with `objects: {binding: subject, zone: graveyard}`, destination battlefield, default owner control, `counters: {"flying": 1}`).
